fusionfix.notes: Install first; the DLAA installer expects a clean FusionFix baseline.

dlss-full.product_name: DLSS 4.5 Super Resolution + DLSS 5 Neural Rendering
dlss-full.settings_surface: Home -> Add-ons -> DLSS 5 Feed -> GTA IV DLSS
dlss-full.hardware_validation: RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, 2560x1440 output. Temporal synchronization was stable across Custom Ultra Quality (77%), Quality, Balanced, Performance and Ultra Performance. Automatic 1485x835 startup stabilization was confirmed to remove cold-start vibration before returning to Ultra Performance. Native DLSS 5 Neural Rendering was also validated on the same GPU.
dlss-full.notes: The combined module installs both Super Resolution and the Neural Rendering runtime while leaving Neural Rendering disabled by default. Normal quality/NR control lives in the ReShade GTA IV DLSS panel; DLSS-Full-Control.bat is launch/repair/diagnostics only. The frozen A3-S2/A3-S5 rendering core is preserved and a small post-checkpoint source stage adds the public ReShade controls. The listed A3-S5 Feeder hash is therefore the pre-UI hardware-reference binary, not the expected byte identity of the current public Feeder. The older startup_prime keys are retained for tooling compatibility. Local builds use frozen source plus build/CPU gates; PE hashes can differ with local MSVC revisions.

reshade.notes: Full Add-On Support, Vulkan global layer. The cross-process input patch is built from the exact v6.8.0 source tag.

nvngx_dlssnr.notes: Downloaded and hash-verified automatically by Install-DLSS-Full.bat. Known-good on RTX 4070 Ti SUPER. Installed to .trex/m3k/nvngx_dlssnr.dll and left OFF until the user enables Neural Rendering from Home -> Add-ons -> DLSS 5 Feed -> GTA IV DLSS.

m3k-dxvk-presenter.product: M3K DXVK render/output presenter for DLSS Super Resolution
m3k-dxvk-presenter.notes: Frozen M3K source-tap + A2-S1B presenter. Reads m3k-nr.ini, overrides GTA IV D3D9 render extent from RenderWidth/RenderHeight, and resizes the real presenter to OutputWidth/OutputHeight or the monitor when output is 0x0.
